# esp-web-tools 10.4.0 (vendored)

Vendored from https://www.npmjs.com/package/esp-web-tools (10.4.0), `dist/web/`,
so the ARGUS flasher has no runtime CDN dependency. unpkg stopped sending a
CORS header for the module (2026-09-09), which is why this is vendored rather
than loaded from a CDN.

Project: https://github.com/esphome/esp-web-tools
License: Apache-2.0

Do not edit these files; refresh by re-vendoring a newer release.
